description: India GST, domestic supplies by a regular registered dealer: CGST+SGST/UTGST vs IGST, rounding, discounts, shipping, inclusive prices, exempt supplies, required-field checks and rate effective dates.

cases.explain: Intra-state B2B service (Karnataka to Karnataka) at 18%: CGST 9% + SGST 9%. L1: 2 x 500000 = 1000000, taxable 1000000 (CGST 9% 90000, SGST 9% 90000); tax lines: CGST 9% on 1000000 = 90000, SGST 9% on 1000000 = 90000; total = taxable 1000000 + tax 180000 + round-off 0 = 1180000.

Inter-state B2B (Karnataka to Maharashtra) at 18%: IGST 18%. L1: 2 x 500000 = 1000000, taxable 1000000 (IGST 18% 180000); tax lines: IGST 18% on 1000000 = 180000; total = taxable 1000000 + tax 180000 + round-off 0 = 1180000.

Intra-state goods at 5% and 18% with a decimal quantity; tax rounded per line and component. L1: 2.5 x 24000 = 60000, taxable 60000 (CGST 2.5% 1500, SGST 2.5% 1500); L2: 1 x 123450 = 123450, taxable 123450 (CGST 9% 11111, SGST 9% 11111); tax lines: CGST 2.5% on 60000 = 1500, SGST 2.5% on 60000 = 1500, CGST 9% on 123450 = 11111, SGST 9% on 123450 = 11111; total = taxable 183450 + tax 25222 + round-off 28 = 208700.

CGST and SGST each land exactly on half a paisa (1150 x 9% = 103.5) and round away from zero; grand total rounds up to the rupee. L1: 1 x 1150 = 1150, taxable 1150 (CGST 9% 104, SGST 9% 104); tax lines: CGST 9% on 1150 = 104, SGST 9% on 1150 = 104; total = taxable 1150 + tax 208 + round-off 42 = 1400.

Grand total 1234.40 rounds down to 1234.00 (round-off -0.40). L1: 1 x 104610 = 104610, taxable 104610 (IGST 18% 18830); tax lines: IGST 18% on 104610 = 18830; total = taxable 104610 + tax 18830 + round-off -40 = 123400.

Grand total ends in exactly 50 paise and rounds up (half away from zero). L1: 1 x 10000 = 10000, taxable 10000 (IGST 5% 500); L2: 1 x 4750 = 4750, taxable 4750 (IGST 0% 0); tax lines: IGST 5% on 10000 = 500, IGST 0% on 4750 = 0; total = taxable 14750 + tax 500 + round-off 50 = 15300.

Same as round-off-down but the user turned round-off off. L1: 1 x 104610 = 104610, taxable 104610 (IGST 18% 18830); tax lines: IGST 18% on 104610 = 18830; total = taxable 104610 + tax 18830 + round-off 0 = 123440.

Supply within Chandigarh (a UT without legislature): CGST + UTGST instead of SGST. L1: 10 x 45000 = 450000, taxable 450000 (CGST 9% 40500, UTGST 9% 40500); tax lines: CGST 9% on 450000 = 40500, UTGST 9% on 450000 = 40500; total = taxable 450000 + tax 81000 + round-off 0 = 531000.

10% line discount reduces the taxable value before tax. L1: 3 x 333333 less 10% = 899999, taxable 899999 (CGST 9% 81000, SGST 9% 81000); tax lines: CGST 9% on 899999 = 81000, SGST 9% on 899999 = 81000; total = taxable 899999 + tax 162000 + round-off 1 = 1062000.

Invoice discount of 100.00 split across two lines in proportion (largest remainder), before tax. L1: 1 x 70000 = 70000, invoice discount -7000, taxable 63000 (IGST 18% 11340); L2: 1 x 30001 = 30001, invoice discount -3000, taxable 27001 (IGST 5% 1350); tax lines: IGST 18% on 63000 = 11340, IGST 5% on 27001 = 1350; total = taxable 90001 + tax 12690 + round-off 9 = 102700.

Shipping of 500.00 is taxed at the rate of the principal (largest) line, 5%. L1: 20 x 24000 = 480000, taxable 480000 (CGST 2.5% 12000, SGST 2.5% 12000); L2: 2 x 15000 = 30000, taxable 30000 (CGST 9% 2700, SGST 9% 2700); shipping 50000, taxable 50000; tax lines: CGST 2.5% on 530000 = 13250, SGST 2.5% on 530000 = 13250, CGST 9% on 30000 = 2700, SGST 9% on 30000 = 2700; total = taxable 560000 + tax 31900 + round-off 0 = 591900.

Tax-inclusive price of 1,000.00 at 18% intra-state: each 9% component = 100000 x 9/118; the typed total is kept exactly. L1: 1 x 100000 = 100000, taxable 84746 (CGST 9% 7627, SGST 9% 7627); tax lines: CGST 9% on 84746 = 7627, SGST 9% on 84746 = 7627; total = taxable 84746 + tax 15254 + round-off 0 = 100000.

Tax-inclusive prices at 5% and 18% inter-state (IGST). L1: 3 x 31500 = 94500, taxable 90000 (IGST 5% 4500); L2: 1 x 249900 = 249900, taxable 211780 (IGST 18% 38120); tax lines: IGST 5% on 90000 = 4500, IGST 18% on 211780 = 38120; total = taxable 301780 + tax 42620 + round-off 0 = 344400.

Regular dealer selling only exempt goods issues a Bill of Supply with no tax. L1: 10 x 5600 = 56000, taxable 56000 (no tax); tax lines: exempt 0% on 56000 = 0; total = taxable 56000 + tax 0 + round-off 0 = 56000.

Taxable and exempt lines together: Tax Invoice with a separate exempt group. L1: 2 x 42000 = 84000, taxable 84000 (CGST 2.5% 2100, SGST 2.5% 2100); L2: 10 x 5600 = 56000, taxable 56000 (no tax); tax lines: CGST 2.5% on 84000 = 2100, SGST 2.5% on 84000 = 2100, exempt 0% on 56000 = 0; total = taxable 140000 + tax 4200 + round-off 0 = 144200.

Unregistered buyer, invoice total of 50,000 or more, buyer address missing: warning buyer_details_required. L1: 1 x 4500000 = 4500000, taxable 4500000 (CGST 9% 405000, SGST 9% 405000); tax lines: CGST 9% on 4500000 = 405000, SGST 9% on 4500000 = 405000; total = taxable 4500000 + tax 810000 + round-off 0 = 5310000.

B2B invoice by a small taxpayer (turnover unknown, first tier: 4 digits) with a line missing its HSN/SAC code. L1: 1 x 100000 = 100000, taxable 100000 (CGST 9% 9000, SGST 9% 9000); L2: 1 x 5000 = 5000, taxable 5000 (CGST 9% 450, SGST 9% 450); tax lines: CGST 9% on 105000 = 9450, SGST 9% on 105000 = 9450; total = taxable 105000 + tax 18900 + round-off 0 = 123900.

Seller turnover above 5 crore needs 6-digit codes even for B2C; a 4-digit code is flagged. L1: 1 x 6500000 = 6500000, taxable 6500000 (CGST 9% 585000, SGST 9% 585000); L2: 1 x 150000 = 150000, taxable 150000 (CGST 9% 13500, SGST 9% 13500); tax lines: CGST 9% on 6650000 = 598500, SGST 9% on 6650000 = 598500; total = taxable 6650000 + tax 1197000 + round-off 0 = 7847000.

The 12% rate ended on 2025-09-21; using it for a supply on 2025-10-01 raises rate_not_effective but still computes. L1: 10 x 10000 = 100000, taxable 100000 (IGST 12% 12000); tax lines: IGST 12% on 100000 = 12000; total = taxable 100000 + tax 12000 + round-off 0 = 112000.

Invoice issued after the change for a supply made on 2025-09-15, when 12% was still in force: no warning. L1: 10 x 10000 = 100000, taxable 100000 (IGST 12% 12000); tax lines: IGST 12% on 100000 = 12000; total = taxable 100000 + tax 12000 + round-off 0 = 112000.

A quotation computes exactly like an invoice but is titled Quotation. L1: 1 x 2400000 = 2400000, taxable 2400000 (CGST 9% 216000, SGST 9% 216000); tax lines: CGST 9% on 2400000 = 216000, SGST 9% on 2400000 = 216000; total = taxable 2400000 + tax 432000 + round-off 0 = 2832000.

Walk-in customer with no country and no state: domestic, place of supply = seller's state (Karnataka), CGST + SGST. L1: 3 x 5000 = 15000, taxable 15000 (CGST 9% 1350, SGST 9% 1350); tax lines: CGST 9% on 15000 = 1350, SGST 9% on 15000 = 1350; total = taxable 15000 + tax 2700 + round-off 0 = 17700.

Buyer with a state (Maharashtra) but no country: domestic, place of supply 27, so IGST; a missing country never means foreign. L1: 3 x 5000 = 15000, taxable 15000 (IGST 18% 2700); tax lines: IGST 18% on 15000 = 2700; total = taxable 15000 + tax 2700 + round-off 0 = 17700.

Two of three lines use the 12% rate that ended on 2025-09-21: one rate_not_effective issue listing lines 0 and 2. L1: 10 x 10000 = 100000, taxable 100000 (IGST 12% 12000); L2: 5 x 4000 = 20000, taxable 20000 (IGST 5% 1000); L3: 4 x 8000 = 32000, taxable 32000 (IGST 12% 3840); tax lines: IGST 12% on 132000 = 15840, IGST 5% on 20000 = 1000; total = taxable 152000 + tax 16840 + round-off -40 = 168800.
